findings.description: JWT secret fallback to weak hardcoded value 'superSecret'
findings.remediation: Remove the fallback and require JWT_SECRET environment variable to be set in production

evidence.benchmark: Should be a strong random string of at least 32 bytes

findings.description: Sequential execution of count and findMany queries for the same filter, causing extra database load
findings.remediation: Run both queries concurrently using Promise.all to reduce database roundtrips

evidence.snippet:
const articlesCount = await prisma.article.count({ ... });
const articles = await prisma.article.findMany({ ... });
evidence.benchmark: Could reduce database load by up to 50% for read operations

findings.description: API endpoint lacks input validation at the boundary (controller), relying on service-layer validation
findings.remediation: Add input validation middleware or controller-level validation for request body

evidence.benchmark: Should validate request body before processing

findings.description: CORS middleware configured to allow all origins, posing a security risk
findings.remediation: Restrict CORS origins to specific domains in production

findings.description: Missing security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, etc.) to protect against common web vulnerabilities
findings.remediation: Add security headers middleware (e.g., helmet) to set protective HTTP headers

evidence.benchmark: Should include headers like Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, etc.
